basics.description: EMP deploys and manages FileDS and BlockDS clusters. This creates the network for them, a compute gallery with the EMP image taken from the VHD warehouse, and the EMP virtual machine. Every new resource is named after the deployment name.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Pick a region with Premium SSD v2 if the clusters go in the same region. FileDS and BlockDS data disks are Premium SSD v2 only.

basics.name: deploymentName
basics.label: Deployment name
basics.toolTip: Prefix for every resource this creates: fds1 gives fds1-emp, fds1-vnet, fds1-mgmt, fds1-data, fds1-mgmt-nsg, fds1_gal.

constraints.validationMessage: 3-12 lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, starting with a letter.

basics.name: warehouseAccount
basics.label: Storage account name
basics.toolTip: The VHD warehouse. The newest emp-<version>.vhd in its emp container is deployed.

basics.name: warehouseSas
basics.toolTip: A SAS with read and list on the emp container, with or without the leading ?. Used during the deployment only.

constraints.validationMessage: Paste the SAS token: the query string with sv=, sp= and sig=.

options.text: [concat('Ebdsv5 vCPU quota in ', location(), ': ', string(sub(first(filter(basics('usages').value, (u) => equals(u.name.value, 'standardEBDSv5Family'))).limit, first(filter(basics('usages').value, (u) => equals(u.name.value, 'standardEBDSv5Family'))).currentValue)), ' free of ', string(first(filter(basics('usages').value, (u) => equals(u.name.value, 'standardEBDSv5Family'))).limit), '. A cluster of three E8bds_v5 controllers needs 24. EMP itself does not use it.')]

toolTip.virtualNetwork: A new network, or one that already exists in this region.
toolTip.subnets: Management (EMP and the controllers' management NICs) and data (where clients mount and log in).

options.text: [concat('Each subnet gets its own NSG on the subnet (', basics('deploymentName'), '-mgmt-nsg and ', basics('deploymentName'), '-data-nsg), none on NICs. Inside the network: SSH and HTTPS to management, NFS, SMB and iSCSI to data, DNS on both, and the cluster ports. From outside, only the addresses below get in.')]

An existing network is used as it is: its subnets and their NSGs are left alone. EMP needs HTTPS (443) in from wherever you open it, and SSH (22) and 443 to the controllers on the management subnet. Whoever deploys needs join rights on the subnet.

elements.name: adminSource
elements.label: Allow access from
elements.toolTip: Your public IP address (or a CIDR, or several separated by commas). Allowed in on every port to both subnets, as rule admin_any_in.

constraints.validationMessage: IPv4 addresses or CIDRs, separated by commas.

elements.name: publicIp
elements.label: Give EMP a public IP address
elements.toolTip: Untick when EMP is reached over a VPN or peering only.

elements.name: empPrivateIp
elements.label: EMP private IP
elements.toolTip: Leave blank for host 50 of the management subnet (e.g. 10.30.0.50).

constraints.validationMessage: An IPv4 address in the management subnet.

options.text: [concat('The VM is ', basics('deploymentName'), '-emp, with ', basics('deploymentName'), '-emp-nic, ', basics('deploymentName'), '-emp-pip and ', basics('deploymentName'), '-emp-os. The newest EMP image goes in the gallery ', replace(basics('deploymentName'), '-', '_'), '_gal.')]

elements.name: empSize
elements.label: Size
elements.toolTip: EMP and its performance collector fit in 2 vCPUs and 8 GiB.

elements.name: adminUsername
elements.label: Username
elements.toolTip: The Linux user on the EMP VM. EMP's own sign-in is created in the browser on first use.

toolTip.authenticationType: Password, or an SSH public key (password login is then off).
toolTip.password: At least 12 characters with three of: lower case, upper case, a digit, a symbol.
toolTip.sshPublicKey: An OpenSSH public key, e.g. ssh-ed25519 AAAA... user@host
